company.name: PowerX
company.shortDescription: PowerX is a technology startup that creates a line of precision sensors that gather data about a home’s electricity, gas, and water usage.
company.description:
PowerX offers an app that provides a unified view of all energy, devices, and water outlets running in any home.

PowerX’s patent-pending AI technology saves money by learning the routine, automatically optimizing the water heating and providing solutions to help save money and be more efficient. PowerX helps to identify the individual appliances and water outlets like a garden faucet that are driving up the utility bill each month. 

The company was founded in 2020 and based in Brooklyn, New York.
